subject: [PATCH 7/7] selftests/nfsd: add a per-netns rpcbind stub and the listener round-trips

2026-08-10.patch_summary: This patch adds a per-network namespace (netns) rpcbind stub to the selftests/nfsd suite, allowing tests to run within their own netns without relying on the host's rpcbind service. The stub is implemented as a minimal responder that binds to a local socket and responds to RPCBVERS_2 and RPCBVERS_4 requests. The patch also includes new test cases for listener registration and round-trips over TCP, UDP, and IPv6 connections, including edge cases such as empty-list serv destroy and -EBUSY refusal.
